name: Skill Install
description: Install a skill from a GitHub repository URL or local folder path. Validates the skill format, places files in the correct location under $HOME/.studio/skills/, and registers it with the Skills system. Load this skill when the user wants to install, add, or import a skill from GitHub or a local directory.
when_to_use: User provides a GitHub repo URL or local folder path to install a skill
User asks to add, import, or install a skill
User wants to bring in a skill from an external source
